content.what_this_is: This is a letter from Los Almendros school about a trip to the Science Museum.
what_to_do: Pay the trip money at the school office.
Sign the permission form and give it back to the school.
Pack food, water and a coat for your child.
Tell the school if your child has allergies.

by_when.what: Sign and return the permission form.
Tell the school about any allergies.
School trip to the Science Museum. Leaves school at 9:15. Back at 15:30.

safety_lines: Get free advice before you sign or pay. For example, Citizens Advice.
